titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Glory of the King of Ethiopia (ch. 95)
part: ch. 95 — The Glory of the King of Ethiopia
about: The Council of the Fathers declares the king of Ethiopia the most glorious of kings, seed of Shem and king of Zion; the Christ is recalled, the Jews who crucified him are condemned and Ethiopia, which believed, is loved; Gregory then names Mary as the likeness of heavenly Zion, and the Council turns to the Law to begin the prophecies of Christ, starting from Genesis 1.

sentences.t: ፺፭ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኀብሩ ፡ ክብሩ ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ።
sentences.l: 95. At/how they-gathered(?) glory-his of-king-of Ethiopia
sentences.i: Chapter 95: How the glory of the king of Ethiopia was joined (?)
sentences.n: Chapter heading, obscure (?). ኀበ is a preposition 'at, to, with' but, as at the head of a title, 'how' (?); ኀብሩ is either the verb 'they gathered/agreed' (3mp perfect) or a noun ኅብር 'union' + -ሁ 'his' (?); ክብሩ is ክብር 'glory' + -ሁ 'his'; ለንጉሠ is ለ- + ንጉሥ in the construct state before ኢትዮጵያ ('of the king of Ethiopia'). The sense 'how his glory is joined/bound up with Zion' fits the chapter but is a guess (?).

sentences.t: ወበእንተሰ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ አእመርነ ፡ ወጠየቅነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይከብር ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወበኵርኒ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እምዘርአ ፡ ሴም ፡ ወማኅደሩሂ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወበህየ ፡ ይሰብር ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ፀሩ ፡ ወጸላእቱ ።
sentences.l: And-concerning-indeed glory-of kings we-knew and-we-inquired that he-is-glorious king-of Ethiopia: king-of Zion he and-in-firstborn(?)-also he from-seed-of Shem, and-dwelling-his-too in Zion of-God he, and-there he-breaks might-of all-them his-enemy and-his-haters.
sentences.i: Concerning the glory of kings, we have learned and inquired that the king of Ethiopia is glorious: he is king of Zion, and he too is a firstborn of the seed of Shem; his dwelling also is in Zion of God, and there he breaks the might of all his enemies and haters.
sentences.n: ወበእንተሰ is ወ- 'and' + በእንተ 'concerning' + emphatic -ሰ; ክብረ ነገሥት is a construct chain, 'glory of kings' (the book's title phrase). ከመ ይከብር is 'that he is glorious' (3ms imperfect of ከብረ). ንጉሠ ጽዮን is 'king of Zion' (construct). ወበኵርኒ is uncertain (?): perhaps ወ- + በኵር 'firstborn' + enclitic -ኒ 'also', 'and he too is a firstborn'. ዘርአ ሴም 'seed of Shem' (Shem as ancestor of the Semitic peoples, Genesis 10:21-31); ማኅደሩሂ is ማኅደር 'dwelling' + -ሁ 'his' + -ሂ 'too'. ኀይለ is construct 'might of'; ፀሩ and ጸላእቱ are 'his enemies' and 'his haters' (plural + -ሁ).

sentences.t: ወእምድኅሬሁ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ሮም ፡ መሲሑ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ መስቀል ፡ ወመንግሥተ ፡ እስራኤልሰ ፡ እምአመ ፡ ተወልደት ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ወእምባሕርይ ፡ ካዕበ ፡ ተወልደ ፡ ፀሐየ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ተሰዊሮ ፡ በሥጋ ፡ ዚአሃ ፡ ወእመሰ ፡ ኢተሰወረ ፡ በሥጋ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ እመ ፡ ኢተርእየ ፡ ለአዕይንተ ፡ መዋቲ ፤
sentences.l: And-after-him king-of Rome anointed-his of-God for-sake-of wood-of cross, and-kingdom-of Israel-indeed from-when she-was-born nature from-them, and-from-nature again was-born sun-of righteousness being-hidden in-flesh her, and-if-indeed not he-was-hidden in-flesh-of man, if not he-appeared to-eyes-of mortal;
sentences.i: After him came the king of Rome, God's anointed, on account of the wood of the cross; and as for the kingdom of Israel, from the time that a nature (a pearl?) was born from them, and from that nature again was born the Sun of Righteousness, veiled in her flesh. For if he had not been veiled in human flesh, if he had not appeared to mortal eyes,
sentences.n: A loose, elliptical sentence. ንጉሠ ሮም is construct, 'king of Rome', and መሲሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his anointed of God' (the emperor as God's anointed, because of Constantine's cross-vision: ዕፀ መስቀል 'wood of the cross', construct). ወመንግሥተ እስራኤልሰ is 'and as for the kingdom of Israel' (construct + emphatic -ሰ). ባሕርይ is 'nature' and also 'pearl', a title of Mary (?); the feminine verb ተወልደት 'she was born' agrees with it, then masculine ተወልደ for the Son. ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'Sun of Righteousness' is Malachi 4:2. ተሰዊሮ 'being hidden/veiled' (converb of ተሰወረ, the incarnation); ዚአሃ 'her'. ወእመሰ ... እመ ኢ- 'and if ... if not' opens a condition that carries over to the next unit.

sentences.t: ለቢሶ ፡ ሥጋነ ፡ ተመሰለ ፡ ኪያነ ፡ ወአንሶሰወ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ወገብረ ፡ ተኣምረ ፡ ወመንክረ ፡ በማእከሌሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: having-put-on flesh-our he-was-likened us, and-he-went-about with-them and-he-did signs and-wonders in-midst-their;
sentences.i: he put on our flesh and was made like us, lived among them, and worked signs and wonders in their midst;
sentences.n: ለቢሶ 'having put on' is a converb (ለብሰ 'wear, put on'); ተመሰለ ኪያነ 'was likened to us', with ኪያነ the accusative 'us'. አንሶሰወ 'he walked about, lived (among)'. ተኣምረ ወመንክረ 'signs and wonders' (accusative). በማእከሌሆሙ is በ- + ማእከል 'middle' + -ሆሙ 'their'.

sentences.t: አንሥአ ፡ ሙታኒሆሙ ፡ ወፈወሰ ፡ ድዉያኒሆሙ ፡ ወአብርሀ ፡ አዕይንተ ፡ ዕዉራኒሆሙ ፡ ወከሠተ ፡ እዝነ ፡ ጽሙማኒሆሙ ፡ ወእለ ፡ ለምጽ ፡ አንጽሐ ፡ ወርኁባነ ፡ አጽገበ ፡ ወብዙኀ ፡ ተኣምረ ፡ ወመንክረ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ዘተጽሕፈ ፡ ወዘኢተጽሕፈ ፤
sentences.l: He-raised dead-their-too and-he-healed sick-their-too and-he-lightened eyes-of blind-their-too and-he-opened ear-of deaf-their-too and-those-who leprosy he-cleansed and-hungry he-satisfied, and-many signs and-wonders he-did, which-was-written and-which-not-was-written;
sentences.i: he raised their dead, healed their sick, gave light to the eyes of their blind and opened the ears of their deaf; he cleansed those with leprosy and fed the hungry; and he did many signs and wonders, both written and unwritten;
sentences.n: Each object carries -ኒ 'also' plus -ሆሙ 'their' (ሙታኒሆሙ 'their dead', ድዉያኒሆሙ 'their sick', ዕዉራኒሆሙ 'their blind', ጽሙማኒሆሙ 'their deaf'). አዕይንተ and እዝነ are construct before the next word ('eyes of', 'ear of'). Echoes Isaiah 35:5-6 and Matthew 11:5. እለ ለምጽ 'those (of) leprosy'; አጽገበ 'he satisfied' (causative); ዘተጽሕፈ ወዘኢተጽሕፈ 'what was written and what was not written' (ዘ- relative).

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ዮሐንስ ፡ ወንጌላዊ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዘብዴዎስ ፡ ሶበሰ ፡ ተጽሕፈ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ እመ ፡ ኢያግመሮ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ጥቀ ፡ መጻሕፍ ፡ ቲሁ ፡ ዘእምተጽሕፈ ።
sentences.l: According-as said John evangelist son-of Zebedee: if-indeed it-were-written all which did Jesus, not would-contain-it world indeed books-its which-from-written.
sentences.i: As John the evangelist, son of Zebedee, said: if everything Jesus did were written down, the world itself could not hold the books that would be written.
sentences.n: Allusion to John 21:25 (given as a paraphrase, not a quotation). በከመ ይቤ 'according as he said'; ወልደ ዘብዴዎስ 'son of Zebedee' (ዘ- as genitive marker). ሶበሰ ... እመ ኢ- 'if ... would not' is a contrary-to-fact condition. The wordspace in መጻሕፍ ፡ ቲሁ splits one word, መጻሕፍቲሁ 'its books', and ዘእምተጽሕፈ is read as 'that would be written' (?); ኢያግመሮ 'would not contain it' (?, a verb of holding, so read from the Gospel parallel).

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ርእዩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዐላዊያን ፡ አምሰልዎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወቀንኡ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ በዘ ፡ ርእዩ ፡ ወሰምዑ ፡ ወሰቀልዎ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ መስቀል ፡ ወቀተልዎ ፤
sentences.l: And-this all when they-saw sons-of Israel rebels they-thought-him like man and-they-envied against-him for-what they-saw and-they-heard, and-they-hanged-him upon wood-of cross and-they-killed-him;
sentences.i: When the children of Israel, the rebels, saw all this, they took him for a mere man, and they envied him because of what they saw and heard; they hanged him on the wood of the cross and killed him;
sentences.n: ወዘንተ ኵሎ 'and this, all' (accusative). ደቂቀ is construct plural 'sons of' (ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel'); ዐላዊያን 'rebels, transgressors' (plural). አምሰልዎ ከመ ሰብእ 'they likened him to a man', that is, they regarded him as an ordinary man. ወቀንኡ 'and they were jealous' (ቀንአ). ሰቀልዎ ... ወቀተልዎ: perfects with the suffix -ዎ 'him'. This is the first of three charges against 'the Jews' in this chapter's polemic, in the voice of the Council.

sentences.t: ወተንሥአ ፡ እሙታን ፡ በሣልስት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወዐርገ ፡ ሰማያተ ፡ በስብሐት ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ መለኮት ፡ ወተወፈየ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ አብ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ዘኢየኀልቅ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ላዕለ ፡ መንፈሳዊያን ፡ ወመሬታዊያን ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፍጥረት ፡ ከመ ፡ ለስሙ ፡ ይግነይ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ልሳን ፡ ወይስግድ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ብርክ ፡ ወይኴንን ፡ ሕያዋነ ፡ ወሙታነ ፡ ወይፈድዮ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ በከመ ፡ ምግባሩ ።
sentences.l: And-he-rose from-dead on-third day and-he-ascended heavens in-glory upon throne-of divinity, and-was-given from-with Father kingdom which-not-ends for-world-of world over spiritual-ones and-earthly-ones and-over all creation, that to-name-his should-bow all tongue and-should-worship all knee and-should-rule living and-dead and-should-repay-him to-all according-as deed-his.
sentences.i: On the third day he rose from the dead and ascended into the heavens in glory, to the throne of divinity; and he was given by the Father a kingdom that does not end, for ever and ever, over the spiritual and the earthly and over all creation, so that every tongue should bow to his name and every knee worship, and he should rule the living and the dead and repay each one according to his deeds.
sentences.n: ተንሥአ እሙታን 'he rose from the dead' (እም- 'from'); በሣልስት ዕለት 'on the third day'. መንበረ መለኮት 'throne of divinity' (construct). ተወፈየ is passive 'was given' (a gift), with መንግሥተ 'kingdom' as the thing given; ዘኢየኀልቅ 'which does not end'; ለዓለመ ዓለም 'for ever' (lit. 'to the world of the world'). መንፈሳዊያን ወመሬታዊያን 'spirit-beings and earthly beings'. Echoes Philippians 2:10-11 (every knee, every tongue) and Romans 2:6 (repay each according to deeds); ይግነይ 'should bow, serve' and ይስግድ 'should worship' are jussives after ከመ. This unit is long (38 words) but one sense-unit.

sentences.t: አሜሃኬ ፡ ሀለዎሙ ፡ ለአይሁድ ፡ ይርአይዎ ፡ ወይትኀፈሩ ፡ ወይትኴነኑ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ዘለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: Then-indeed it-is-for-them for-Jews they-see-him and-be-ashamed and-be-judged in-fire of-eternity;
sentences.i: Then it will be for the Jews to see him, and be ashamed, and be condemned in eternal fire;
sentences.n: አሜሃኬ 'then, at that time' + emphatic -ኬ. ሀለዎሙ ለአይሁድ 'it is for them, for the Jews' (ሀለወ 'be, be fitting'); the verbs ይርአይዎ ወይትኀፈሩ ወይትኴነኑ are jussives 'that they see him, be ashamed, be condemned' (ይትኴነኑ is a passive-reflexive stem). ዘለዓለም 'of eternity' (ዘ- genitive). A harsh line of the Council's polemic.

sentences.t: ወንሕነሰ ፡ እለ ፡ አመነ ፡ በርትዕት ፡ ሃይማኖት ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበርነ ፡ ንሄሉ ፡ ወንትፌሣሕ ፡ ምስለ ፡ መምህራን ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ ለእመ ፡ ሖርነ ፡ በፍኖተ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወበትእዛዛቲሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-we-indeed those-who believed in-right faith upon throne-our we-shall-be and-we-shall-rejoice with teachers apostles if we-walked in-way-of Christ and-in-commandments-his;
sentences.i: But we, who have believed in the right faith, shall sit upon our throne and rejoice with the teachers, the apostles, if we walk in the way of Christ and in his commandments;
sentences.n: ወንሕነሰ 'and as for us' (ንሕነ 'we' + -ሰ). እለ አመነ 'those who believed' (relative plural with a plain perfect). ንሄሉ 'we shall be/dwell' (ሀለወ) and ንትፌሣሕ 'we shall rejoice' (ተፈሥሐ). መምህራን ሐዋርያት 'teachers, apostles' (apposition). ለእመ ሖርነ 'if we went/walk'; በፍኖተ ክርስቶስ 'in the way of Christ' (construct); ትእዛዛቲሁ 'his commandments' (plural + -ሁ). Compare Matthew 19:28 on thrones.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ሰቀሉ ፡ መድኀኔ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ኮኑ ፡ ዝርዋነ ፡ ወመንግሥቶሙ ፡ ኮነት ፡ ብዲተ ፡ ወኀልቁ ፡ ወተሠረዉ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፨
sentences.l: And-when they-hanged saviour-of world they-became scattered-ones and-kingdom-their became desolate(?) and-they-perished and-were-uprooted until for-world-of world.
sentences.i: And when they crucified the Savior of the world, they became scattered, and their kingdom became desolate (?); they perished and were uprooted for ever.
sentences.n: ሰቀሉ 'they hanged/crucified'; መድኀኔ ዓለም 'Savior of the world' (construct). ዝርዋን 'scattered' (ዘርወ 'scatter'); ብዲተ is uncertain (?), read as 'desolate, laid waste'. ኀልቁ 'they perished' (ኀለቀ); ተሠረዉ 'they were uprooted' (ተሠርወ, passive of ሠረወ 'root out'). እስከ ለዓለመ ዓለም 'until for ever'. ፨ closes the paragraph of argument against the Jews.

sentences.t: ወይቤሉ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ማኅበረ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ ጥዩቀ ፡ በአማን ፡ የዐቢ ፡ ወይትሌ ፡ ዐል ፡ ወይከብር ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ እምኵሎሙ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ምድር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ክብራ ፡ ወዕበያ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ሰማያዊት ፤
sentences.l: And-they-said all-them assembly-of saints: certainly in-truth he-is-great and-he-follows(?) exalted(?) and-he-is-glorious king-of Ethiopia from-all-them kings-of earth for-sake-of glory-her and-greatness-her of-Zion heavenly;
sentences.i: And all the assembly of the saints said: Truly and certainly, the king of Ethiopia is greater, exalted and more glorious than all the kings of the earth, because of the glory and greatness of heavenly Zion;
sentences.n: ኵሎሙ ማኅበረ ቅዱሳን 'all of them, the assembly of the saints' (ማኅበረ construct). ጥዩቀ በአማን 'certainly, in truth'. የዐቢ 'he is great' (ዐብየ); ወይትሌ ዐል is unclear (?): perhaps ይትለዐል 'is exalted' split by a wordspace, or a verb 'follows' + 'exalted'. ይከብር እም- 'is more glorious than'. በእንተ ክብራ ወዕበያ ለጽዮን 'because of her glory and her greatness, of Zion' (a pronoun suffix anticipating the owner, ለጽዮን). ሰማያዊት is feminine 'heavenly'.

sentences.t: ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አፍቀሮሙ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ያእምሩ ፡ ሕጎ ፡ ሠረዉ ፡ ጣዖቶሙ ፡ ወእለሰ ፡ ተውህቦሙ ፡ ሕገ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ገብሩ ፡ ጣዖተ ፡ ወሰገዲ ፡ ለአማልክት ፡ ዘይጸልእ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፨
sentences.l: And-God he-loved-them people-of Ethiopia for before they-knew law-his they-uprooted idols-their; and-those-indeed to-whom-was-given law-of God they-made idol and-worship to-gods which hates God.
sentences.i: And God loved the people of Ethiopia, because before they knew his law they overthrew their idols; but those to whom the law of God was given made idols and worshipped gods whom God hates.
sentences.n: አፍቀሮሙ ለሕዝበ ኢትዮጵያ 'he loved them, the people of Ethiopia' (the pronoun -ሙ doubles the ለ- object; ሕዝበ construct). እስመ ዘእንበለ ያእምሩ 'for before they knew' (ዘእንበለ 'without, before' + jussive). ሕጎ 'his law' (accusative, ሕግ + -ሁ). ሠረዉ 'they uprooted' (ሠረወ, as in the previous unit). ወእለሰ ተውህቦሙ 'and as for those to whom was given'; ሰገዲ 'worship' (noun); ዘይጸልእ እግዚኣብሔር 'whom God hates'. Contrasts Ethiopia with Israel (Exodus 32).

sentences.t: ወበደኃሪ ፡ አመ ፡ ተወልደ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይቤዝዎ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ገብረ ፡ ተኣምረ ፡ ወመንክረ ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ወኢአምኑ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ኢበስብከቱ ፡ ወኢበስብከተ ፡ አበዊሁ ፡ ወሕዝበ ፡ ኢትዮጵያሰ ፡ አምኑ ፡ በ፩ ፡ ረድእ ፡ መሀይምን ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ አፍቀሮሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፨
sentences.l: And-in-last when he-was-born that they-redeem-him Adam he-did signs and-wonders in-presence-their, and-not they-believed in-him neither-in-preaching-his nor-in-preaching-of fathers-his; and-people-of Ethiopia-indeed they-believed in-one disciple faithful, and-because-of-this he-loved-them God exceedingly people-of Ethiopia.
sentences.i: And in the last days, when he was born to redeem Adam, he did signs and wonders before them, and they did not believe in him, neither in his preaching nor in the preaching of his fathers; but the people of Ethiopia believed through one faithful disciple, and for this reason God loved the people of Ethiopia exceedingly.
sentences.n: በደኃሪ 'in the last (time)'. ከመ ይቤዝዎ ለአዳም 'that he might redeem Adam' (ይቤዝዎ has the object suffix -ዎ, doubled by ለአዳም). ኢአምኑ ቦቱ 'they did not believe in him'; ኢበስብከቱ ወኢበስብከተ አበዊሁ 'neither in his preaching nor in the preaching of his fathers' (the prophets). በ፩ ረድእ መሀይምን 'in/through one faithful disciple'. The text does not name him; the reader may think of Philip and the Ethiopian official (Acts 8) (?). ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. ፨ marks the speech's end.

sentences.t: አውሥኡ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ጳጳሳት ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ነበብከ ፡ ወርቱዕ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ወጥዩቀ ፡ ፈከርከ ፡ ወተርጐምከ ፡ ለነ ፤
sentences.l: They-answered and-they-said-to-him bishops: well you-spoke and-right word-your and-exactly you-declared and-you-interpreted to-us;
sentences.i: The bishops answered and said to him: You have spoken well; your word is true; you have explained and interpreted it exactly for us;
sentences.n: አውሥኡ ወይቤልዎ 'they answered and said to him' (ይቤልዎ = ይቤሉ + ዎ). ጳጳሳት 'bishops'. ሠናየ ነበብከ 'you spoke well' (ነበበ 'speak'); ጥዩቀ is an adverb 'exactly'; ፈከርከ 'you explained' and ተርጐምከ 'you interpreted' (2ms perfects). The address is to the speaker of the previous unit.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ጳውሎስ ፡ አኮኑ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ አልዐለ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ሴም ፤
sentences.l: According-as said Paul: is-it-not seed-of Abraham he-exalted he seed-of Shem;
sentences.i: As Paul said: Is it not that the seed of Abraham is exalted, that is, the seed of Shem?
sentences.n: Probably not a quotation of Paul but an echo of Romans 4 and 9 and Galatians 3:29 (?). አኮኑ 'is it not so that' (a question). አልዐለ is causative 'he exalted' (or 'it is exalted', (?)); ውእቱ 'he/that is' glosses the seed of Abraham as the seed of Shem. ዘርአ is construct before አብርሃም and ሴም.

sentences.t: ኵሎሙ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ወኅሩያኒሁ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: All-them kings-of earth they and-chosen-ones-his of-God people-of Ethiopia;
sentences.i: They are all kings of the earth, and God's chosen ones are the people of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: ኵሎሙ ነገሥተ ምድር እሙንቱ 'they are all kings of the earth' (እሙንቱ 'they', the copula); ወኅሩያኒሁ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'and his chosen ones, God's' (ኅሩይ 'chosen', plural ኅሩያን, + -ኒ + -ሁ; the ለ- repeats the owner). ሰብአ ኢትዮጵያ 'men of Ethiopia' (construct).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ማኅደሩ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኮነት ፡ ህየ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ወታቦተ ፡ ኪዳኑ ፡ እንተ ፡ ረሰያ ፡ ለምሥሃል ፡ በእንተ ፡ ምሕረተ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ለክራማት ፡ ወለዝናማት ፡ ለአትክልት ፡ ወለፍረያት ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ወለበሓውርት ፡ ለነገሥት ፡ ወለመኳንንት ፡ ለሰብእ ፡ ወለእንስሳ ፡ ለአዕዋፍ ፡ ወለአራዊት ፨
sentences.l: For dwelling-his of-God was there Zion heavenly ark-of law-his and-ark-of covenant-his which she-appointed-her for-mercy-seat for-sake-of mercy-of sons-of man for-seasons-of-cold(?) and-for-rains for-plants and-for-fruits for-peoples and-for-lands(?) for-kings and-for-rulers for-man and-for-beast for-birds and-for-wild-animals.
sentences.i: For the dwelling of God was there, heavenly Zion, the ark of his law and the ark of his covenant, which he made a mercy seat out of mercy toward the children of men: for the cold seasons (?) and for the rains, for plants and for fruits, for the peoples and for the lands (?), for kings and for rulers, for people and for beasts, for birds and for wild animals.
sentences.n: ማኅደሩ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the dwelling of God' (ለ- repeats the owner). ጽዮን ሰማያዊት 'heavenly Zion' is the Ark itself (ታቦተ ሕጉ 'ark of his law', ታቦተ ኪዳኑ 'ark of his covenant', both construct; ኪዳን 'covenant'). እንተ ረሰያ ለምሥሃል 'which he made her (into) a place of mercy', i.e. the mercy seat (Exodus 25:17-22). ምሕረተ ውሉደ ሰብእ 'mercy of the sons of man' (two constructs). Then a series of pairs, each ለ- 'for': ክራማት (?) read 'winters, cold or rainy seasons', ዝናማት 'rains', አትክልት 'plants', ፍረያት 'fruits', አሕዛብ 'peoples', በሓውርት (?) uncertain, perhaps 'lands, wildernesses', ነገሥት, መኳንንት 'rulers', ሰብእ, እንስሳ 'beasts', አዕዋፍ 'birds', አራዊት 'wild animals'. Zion's care covers the whole world.

sentences.t: አውሥአ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ጎርጎርዮስ ፡ ጳጳስ ፡ ገባሬ ፡ መንክር ፡ በአማን ፡ ተውህበት ፡ ለነ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ለኵልነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ከርስቲያን ፡ ለእለ ፡ አመነ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ለእግዝእትነ ፡ ማርያም ፡ አምሳሊሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ሰማያዊት ፤
sentences.l: He-answered and-he-said-to-them Gregory bishop worker-of wonder: in-truth was-given to-us salvation for-all-us people-of Christian for-those-who believed in-her, in-lady-our Mary likeness-her of-Zion heavenly;
sentences.i: Gregory the bishop, the wonder-worker, answered and said to them: In truth salvation was given to us, to all of us, the Christian people who believed in her, in our lady Mary, the likeness of heavenly Zion;
sentences.n: ጎርጎርዮስ ጳጳስ ገባሬ መንክር 'Gregory the bishop, worker of wonder' (ገባሬ construct); the epithet is as in the text, and the text itself does not say which Gregory (?). ተውህበት is feminine passive 'was given' (the subject መድኀኒት 'salvation' is feminine). ለኵልነ 'to all of us'; ሕዝበ ከርስቲያን 'the Christian people' (construct). ለእለ አመነ ባቲ 'to those who believed in her'. እግዝእትነ ማርያም 'our lady Mary'. አምሳሊሃ ለጽዮን 'her likeness, of Zion': Mary is the Ark's type; the Ark/Zion/Mary equation is central to the book.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኀደረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሠ ፡ ድንግል ፡ ወተወልደ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሩካቤ ፡ ወበአጽባዕተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ተጽሕፈ ፡ ፲ ፡ ቃላት ፡ ዘሕግ ፡ ተገብረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: For he-dwelt God in womb-of virgin and-was-born from-her without intercourse; and-with-fingers-of God was-written 10 words of-law, it-was-made in Zion ark-of law-his of-God.
sentences.i: For God dwelt in the womb of a virgin and was born of her without intercourse; and the ten words of the law were written with the fingers of God, and (this) was made in Zion, the ark of God's law.
sentences.n: ኀደረ ... ውስተ ከርሠ ድንግል 'dwelt in the womb of a virgin' (ከርሠ construct), the same verb used for the Spirit in the last unit. ዘእንበለ ሩካቤ 'without intercourse'. አጽባዕተ is construct plural 'fingers of' (Exodus 31:18; Deuteronomy 9:10); ፲ ቃላት ዘሕግ 'the 10 words of the law'. The clause ተገብረ ውስተ ጽዮን ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር is loose (?): 'it was made in Zion, the ark of his law' (i.e. the tablets placed in the Ark, or Zion is itself the Ark).

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ሀቡ ፡ ንንግር ፡ ትንቢቶሙ ፡ ለነቢያት ፡ አበዊነ ፡ ቀደምት ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ እምኦሪተ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወነቢያት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ መድኀኒነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይስምዑ ፡ ደኃሪ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ፍካሬ ፡ ዜና ፡ ዘንዜንዎሙ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ተርጒሞ ፡ መጻሕፍት ።
sentences.l: And-now give-leave we-tell prophecy-their of-prophets fathers-our former saints from-law-of Moses and-prophets concerning Christ saviour-our, that they-may-hear later generation interpretation-of account which-we-tell-them concerning interpreting-of books.
sentences.i: And now, grant that we may tell the prophecies of the prophets, our holy fathers of old, from the Law of Moses and the Prophets, concerning Christ our Savior, so that a later generation may hear the explanation of the account that we tell them in the interpreting of the books.
sentences.n: ሀቡ ንንግር 'give (leave), let us tell' (imperative plural + 1cp jussive of ነገረ). ትንቢቶሙ ለነቢያት 'the prophecy of the prophets' (ትንቢት + -ሙ with ለ-); አበዊነ 'our fathers' (irregular plural + -ነ), ቀደምት ቅዱሳን 'former, holy'. እምኦሪተ ሙሴ 'from the Law of Moses' (construct); ወነቢያት 'and the Prophets', the usual two-part Scripture. ደኃሪ ትውልድ 'later generation'; ፍካሬ ዜና 'explanation of the account' (construct); ዘንዜንዎሙ 'which we shall tell them' (ነገረ/ዜነወ causative-type verb, 1cp + -ሙ). ተርጒሞ መጻሕፍት 'interpreting of books' (infinitive in construct).

sentences.t: ነአኀዝኬ ፡ እምርእሰ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፡ ወንለቡ ፡ በመንፈስ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ በመንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፡ ተጽሕፈ ፡ በእንቲአየ ፨
sentences.l: We-begin-then from-head-of book and-let-us-understand in-spirit according-as said David in-spirit holy: in-head-of book it-is-written concerning-me;
sentences.i: Let us begin, then, from the head of the book, and let us understand in the Spirit, as David said in the Holy Spirit: In the head of the book it is written of me;
sentences.n: ነአኀዝኬ 'let us begin, then' (አኀዘ + emphatic -ኬ); ርእሰ መጽሐፍ 'head of the book' (construct), here the Pentateuch (see the next question). ንለቡ 'let us understand' (ለበወ). A quotation of Psalm 40:7 (Septuagint 39:8) (Hebrews 10:7), 'in the head of the book it is written of me'. በእንቲአየ 'concerning me' (በእንተ + -የ).

sentences.t: አውሥአ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ምንት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ መጽሐፍ ።
sentences.l: He-answered and-he-said: what he head-of book.
sentences.i: He answered and said: What is the head of the book?
sentences.n: A short question, ምንት ውእቱ 'what is it?'. The speaker is the one who asked about the Psalm's phrase 'head of the book' (the text does not name him).

sentences.t: አውሥኡ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ ኦሪት ፡ ዘተጽሕፈ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: They-answered and-they-said-to-him: this-is Law which-was-written concerning Christ son-of God;
sentences.i: They answered and said to him: This is the Law, which was written concerning Christ, the Son of God;
sentences.n: ዝውእቱ 'this is' (ዝ + ውእቱ written as one word). ኦሪት 'the Law, the Torah' (Greek-derived; Orit is the Geʿez name for the Pentateuch). ወልደ እግዚኣብሔር 'son of God' (construct).

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ በቀዳሚ ፡ ገብረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ፡ ወህልው ፡ እምትካት ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said: in-beginning made God heaven and-earth and-existing from-of-old;
sentences.i: And it says: In the beginning God made heaven and earth, and he existed from of old;
sentences.n: Genesis 1:1. በቀዳሚ 'in the beginning'; ሰማየ ወምድረ accusative, 'heaven and earth'. ወህልው እምትካት is uncertain (?): 'and existing from of old', with እምትካት read as 'from the beginning', but the subject could instead be 'it (the heavens and earth) existed from the beginning'.

sentences.t: ወምድርሰ ፡ ኢኮነት ፡ ድሉተ ፡ አላ ፡ ድሙራን ፡ ጽልመት ፡ ወነፋስ ፡ ወማይ ፡ ወጊሜ ፡ ወመሬት ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ድሙራን ፡ ወመንፈሰ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይጼልል ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ማይ ፤
sentences.l: And-earth-indeed not-was prepared but mixed-ones darkness and-wind and-water and-mist and-soil all-them mixed-ones, and-spirit-of God hovers above water;
sentences.i: And the earth was not made ready, but was confused: darkness and wind and water and mist and soil, all of them mixed together; and the Spirit of God hovered over the water;
sentences.n: Genesis 1:2 expanded: 'without form and void' is rendered ኢኮነት ድሉተ 'was not prepared' and ድሙራን 'mixed together, confused' (plural; ድሙር). ጽልመት 'darkness', ነፋስ 'wind', ማይ 'water', ጊሜ 'mist, cloud', መሬት 'soil, earth'. መንፈሰ እግዚኣብሔር 'Spirit of God' (construct). ይጼልል 'overshadows, hovers' (a present-tense imperfect in a story); መልዕልተ ማይ 'above the water'.

sentences.t: ዘንተሰ ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ተፈጥሩ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወምድር ፡ ወመንፈሰ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኀደረ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፍጥረት ፡ ብሂል ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: This-indeed which he-said: by-word-of God they-were-created heavens and-earth, and-spirit-of God dwelt upon all creation, saying. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: As for this that he said, 'By the word of God the heavens and the earth were created, and the Spirit of God dwelt upon all creation', that is the saying. (The text ends with a row of ፨ signs.)
sentences.n: ዘንተሰ ዘይቤ 'as for this which he said' (accusative ዘንተ + -ሰ). በቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'by the word of God' (construct); ተፈጥሩ 'were created' (passive of ፈጠረ); ኀደረ 'dwelt', as in the previous unit. ብሂል 'saying, meaning' (noun of ብህለ 'say') closes the explanation; the sentence stands unfinished, and the Council's account of the Law is continued in the following part. The text ends with a row of ፨ marks.
